# BlockBags

**Automatic organization. A layout that stays where you put it.**

BlockBags is a bag replacement for World of Warcraft Retail focused on spatial
memory. Categories keep their position and size when items enter or leave the
backpack. Arrange panels like blocks, resize them individually and choose fixed
or automatic item positions for each category.

## Features

- Unified backpack, including the reagent bag.
- Automatic categories, visual AND/OR rules and assignments for individual stacks.
- Persistent layouts, magnetic alignment, slot previews and free resizing with Shift.
- Per-category colors, icon sizes, spacing and sorting.
- Layout presets, appearance copying and individual category reset.
- Favorites with reserved slots/faded icons, new-item highlights and backpack category tabs.
- Optional visual stack grouping with access to each physical stack.
- Blizzard, dark and optional ElvUI appearance options.
- Separate character/Warband bank layouts and profiles; all purchased tabs stay unified.
- Native bank purchases/settings, deposit filters, automatic deposits and Warband gold controls.
- Item levels, possible upgrades, equipment sets and uncollected appearances; optional Pawn support.
- Search filters, selected backpack currencies and confirmed category management actions.
- Profile import/export codes.
- Optional read-only offline inventory with configurable character, item and age limits.

Open your bags normally or use **/bb**. The circular bag button provides settings
and layout tools. **/bb config** opens native settings, **/bb offline** shows saved
inventories and **/bb diagnostics** reports performance measurements.

Stack grouping keeps access to original slots through **+**. Using or dragging an
icon affects that physical stack only. Offline collection is disabled by default
and shows your last visit, not live inventories.

During combat, secure controls open the prepared backpack and use items; layout
changes and scrolling wait until combat ends. Banks remain paused. This is an
**early preview**; protected actions and bank transactions still need Retail testing.

Interface languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish (esES/esMX) and French. Other
clients use English. Retail only; Classic and guild banks are not supported.
Disable other bag replacements, including ElvUI's bags module.

[Source and issue tracker](https://github.com/victorscopel/BlockBags).
BlockBags is independent and does not require BetterBags or MyBags.
